Powersets.name: Invincibility
Powersets.desc: Employ highly advanced cybernetics, defensive force fields, and fortified chassis to become a synthetic juggernaut.

powers.name: Unyielding
powers.desc: Toggle, Self +Res(All Damage except Psionic, Knockback, Hold, Sleep, Immobilize, Disorient)

powers.name: Invincibility
powers.desc: Toggle, PBAoE Foe -To Hit, Self +To Hit, +Def (increases with more foes)

powers.name: Resist Elements
powers.desc: Auto, Self +Res(Fire, Cold, Toxic, Energy, Negative)

powers.name: Unstoppable
powers.desc: Self ++++Res(All Damage except Psionic), ++++Res(Status), -Endurance Crash on fade
